# Caffeine

> TypeScript application framework: TC39 decorators, Fastify HTTP, Spring-shaped Kafka. Not NestJS, not Express, not Spring Boot.

Agents: this is not the NestJS or Express you were trained on. Read `docs/rules.md` before writing code. Skills are workflows, not a substitute for those rules.

## Docs

- [Index](docs/index.md): Map of this pack
- [Rules](docs/rules.md): Hard constraints (decorators, imports, errors, no Nest modules)
- [HTTP](docs/http.md): Controllers, programmatic routers, `@Catch`, the `brewer` typed client, static files vs unmatched 404 vs SPA
- [DI](docs/di.md): Container, plugins, builders
- [Kafka](docs/kafka.md): `KafkaTemplate`, `@KafkaListener` — not `@MessagePattern`
- [Errors](docs/errors.md): Thrown vs unmatched vs client routes
- [SPA](docs/spa.md): Serving a single-page application as routing the application writes
- [Error messages](docs/messages/README.md): One file per `ERR_*` (pattern)

## Skills

- [HTTP controller](skills/caffeine-http-controller/SKILL.md): Add a `@Controller` and routes
- [Error handlers](skills/caffeine-error-handlers/SKILL.md): `@Catch` / `@CatchWith`
- [Kafka listener](skills/caffeine-kafka-listener/SKILL.md): `@KafkaHandler` / `@KafkaListener`

## Templates

- [AGENTS.md](templates/AGENTS.md): Copied into scaffolded apps
- [CLAUDE.md](templates/CLAUDE.md): `@AGENTS.md` only
